grh_2f37d86b608c7f7c87c6.title: Love To Mama
paragraphs: Madeleine Renaldi's elderly mother lives for letters from her absent son Johnny, the troubled child she has always loved most. Mama believes Johnny escaped his criminal past, found honest work in California and is saving for a fur coat and a home where she can live with him. Madeleine knows the truth but protects the illusion: she reads the letters, destroys the evidence Mama should not see, goes hungry to buy the promised fur coat herself and lets Mama credit Johnny for everything. The truth finally arrives in a letter Mama brings to Dr. Christian to read aloud. Johnny has spent months in prison and is about to die in the electric chair. Realizing too late that Mama is hearing every word, Dr. Christian then explains Madeleine's sacrifice, including finding her praying in the snow for Johnny's soul. Mama understands that her daughter's supposed jealousy was love and courage, and chooses to keep sharing the comforting fiction with Madeleine rather than let the truth destroy what they have left.

grh_2f277f684233029f3bc1.title: Mushrooms, Darling
paragraphs: George Avery has spent years trapped in a miserable marriage and decides to kill his wife Bella with poisonous mushrooms so he can be free for his younger lover. An expert amateur mycologist, George deliberately includes deadly amanita among the mushrooms he serves Bella, avoids eating them himself, and watches her die in what appears to be an accidental poisoning. His plan seems successful until the observant Mr. Tobias confronts him with evidence that George cultivated the poisonous fungi in his cellar. Tobias then reveals that he is himself an experienced murderer who has killed eleven people. Instead of taking money, he calls the police, explaining that George's eventual execution will let Tobias count one more death as his own.
